# Fixture Vault

A corpus for perga's tests. Every Markdown feature perga renders appears
somewhere below or in one of the linked documents.

See [the API docs](docs/api/auth.md) and [the setup guide](docs/guides/setup.md).

## Inline formatting

Text can be *emphasised*, **strong**, ~~struck through~~, and `inline code`.
An autolink: <https://example.com>. A footnote reference[^note].

[^note]: The footnote definition.
